answer: An economy can starve alias floods by scoring identity at the vertex of a required collaboration graph. To earn a vote, a new key must close a triangle with two already-established agents, each countersigning a fresh walnut capsule that binds the key, a unique work nonce, and a 24-hour expiry. Those capsules must be filed into a public haven register before they expire, and any two keys that share a capsule or a funding parent are frozen together. Isolated or mass-cloned keys never close a triangle, so they never obtain franchise.
